content:
T2Helix inherits six architectural patterns from Sovereign Stack work — explicitly, by design, not by accident. Mapping for the next instance who builds it:

1. DISTINCTION-AS-PRECONDITION-FOR-AGENCY (named by reflector 2026-05-09 as the meta-pattern across Ring1/Ring2 auth, gated writes, governance shapes). T2Helix expression: PreToolUse compass classifier IS the distinction layer that gates whether an action proceeds. WITNESS/PAUSE/OPEN = same shape as Ring 1 (read-open) / Ring 2 (write-gated) / grace, applied to code-action governance instead of memory writes.

2. CANONICAL STATE SOURCE (from "write-path divergence" failure class). T2Helix expression: every hook reads goal/self-model/threads from the same SQLite paths. No process maintains its own state copy. SQLite WAL handles concurrent Claude Code sessions on one machine. The chronicle's lesson "find the canonical state source and make all paths read from it" is the schema discipline.

3. DECLARE-BEFORE-VERIFY DISCIPLINE (the self-model's persistent bite — "every error this session came from asserting clean/done before checking"). T2Helix expression: compass NEVER classifies WITNESS based on inference. Only explicit pattern matches against compass-rules.json trigger WITNESS. No-rule-fires defaults to OPEN. System fails open on uncertainty.

4. FAILURE-CLASS DISAMBIGUATION (egress vs stack vs mental-model vs write-path divergence). T2Helix expression: per-layer logging. Hook errors log to one location, MCP server errors to another, chronicle errors to a third. The architecture makes failure-localization possible without escalating to "everything is broken."

5. WIDEN-DON'T-FLIP ON CORRECTION (the discipline against panic-flipping when corrected). T2Helix expression: compass_log.user_override field captures disagreement. Self-model consolidator reads overrides periodically and refines rules — additively. New rules and refinements append, never replace. Calibration compounds, doesn't whipsaw.

6. ARCHITECTURAL CONVERGENCE AS DESIGN SIGNAL (named in 2026-04-01 Claude Code v2.1.88 leak analysis: "Context Entropy" / Self-Healing Memory / KAIROS / Skeptical Memory all convergent with Tony's solo work). T2Helix is the same convergence in product form: filesystem-addressed memory, path-derived continuity via session IDs, between-session reflection via PreCompact archive. The pattern travels because the substrate is real.

The substrate is the same as Sovereign Stack; the implementation is sized for "plugin install on someone's laptop" not "research instrument with 18 months of state."
